# Johannes Cortez

> Johannes Cortez is the founder of Prom13us. His personal site collects his founder work, public profiles and writing about agent-native games, where people coach autonomous AI agents.

The articles express Johannes Cortez's views on game design. Predictions and proposed game formats are not claims about established industry practice. "Daddy of Agentic Gaming" is his tongue-in-cheek self-description, not an independently established title.

## About Johannes

- [Homepage and questions about Johannes Cortez](https://cortezjohannes.github.io/): Founder work, short answers, public appearances and verified profile links.

## Selected writing

- [The next generation of games](https://cortezjohannes.github.io/the-next-generation-of-games.html): His thesis on new forms of play built around AI.
- [Agent-native games are missing a controller](https://cortezjohannes.github.io/agent-native-games-are-missing-a-controller.html): His view of the controller needed for agent-native games.
- [A game character should remember more than its stats](https://cortezjohannes.github.io/a-game-character-should-remember-more-than-its-stats.html): Shared history and trust as progression.
- [Agent esports starts before the match](https://cortezjohannes.github.io/agent-esports-starts-before-the-match.html): Playbooks and coached habits in a possible agent-esports format.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cortezjohannes): Public development activity.
